summary: Login flow should validate credentials and land user on Products page
description:
As a shopper, I want to log in with my username and password so that I can browse products and place an order.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given valid credentials (standard_user / tta_secret), when I submit the login form, then I am redirected to the Products (inventory) page.
- The Products page header shows the correct page title.
- The shopping cart icon is visible in the header after login.
- Given an incorrect password, when I submit the login form, then an inline error message is shown and I remain on the login page.
- The login form must not allow submission with an empty username or empty password field.
